label: iPad Air (5th gen) tablet
description: Apple iPad Air (5th generation, M1) — 10.9-inch tablet, Wi-Fi 6 and 5G sub-6/mmWave on cellular models; USB-C 3.1 Gen 2 with Ethernet support.
notes: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5 GHz). Cellular (optional SKU): 5G sub-6 GHz plus mmWave (US models), LTE fallback. USB-C 3.1 Gen 2 up to 10 Gbps with Ethernet adapter support (usb0) and DisplayPort. M1 tablet: the endpoint most likely to be running a full remote-desktop session, so bandwidth-heavy.
